questions.question: What is a diet? Name three things that affect the foods people eat.
questions.expected_answer: A diet is the selection of foods and drinks that a person eats every day. It is affected by culture and family, religion and beliefs, money, where people live, and likes, dislikes and allergies.

questions.question: What is a balanced diet? Describe a healthy plate.
questions.expected_answer: A balanced diet gives the body all the nutrients it needs in the right amounts: carbohydrates, proteins, fats and oils, and vitamins and minerals, plus water and fibre. About half of a healthy plate is vegetables and fruit, a quarter is starchy food like pap or rice, and a quarter is protein like beans, eggs, chicken or fish, with only a little fat.

questions.question: Why do we need water and fibre?
questions.expected_answer: Water carries nutrients in the blood, removes waste in urine and cools the body through sweat; we lose water all the time, so we must drink it every day. Fibre, or roughage, from vegetables, fruit, beans and whole grains cannot be digested, but it gives bulk to food in the gut, helps prevent constipation and helps us feel full.
